shortDescription: Module for setup of IpamDnsProviderProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: allocate_ip_in_vrf
options.description: If this flag is set, only allocate ip from networks in the virtual service vrf. Applicable for avi ipam only. Field introduced in 17.2.4. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: aws_profile
options.description: Provider details if type is aws. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: azure_profile
options.description: Provider details if type is microsoft azure. Field introduced in 17.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: custom_profile
options.description: Provider details if type is custom. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: gcp_profile
options.description: Provider details if type is google cloud. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: infoblox_profile
options.description: Provider details if type is infoblox. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: internal_profile
options.description: Provider details if type is avi. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the ipam/dns provider profile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: oci_profile
options.description: Provider details for oracle cloud. Field introduced in 18.2.1,18.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: openstack_profile
options.description: Provider details if type is openstack. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: proxy_configuration
options.description: Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tencent_profile
options.description: Provider details for tencent cloud. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: type
options.description: Provider type for the ipam/dns provider profile. Enum options - IPAMDNS_TYPE_INFOBLOX, IPAMDNS_TYPE_AWS, IPAMDNS_TYPE_OPENSTACK, IPAMDNS_TYPE_GCP, IPAMDNS_TYPE_INFOBLOX_DNS, IPAMDNS_TYPE_CUSTOM, IPAMDNS_TYPE_CUSTOM_DNS, IPAMDNS_TYPE_AZURE, IPAMDNS_TYPE_OCI, IPAMDNS_TYPE_TENCENT, IPAMDNS_TYPE_INTERNAL, IPAMDNS_TYPE_INTERNAL_DNS, IPAMDNS_TYPE_AWS_DNS, IPAMDNS_TYPE_AZURE_DNS. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- ipamdns

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the ipam/dns provider profile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
